import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Get top marker genes for each cluster
def get_top_markers(cluster_id, n=10):
    cluster_mask = adata.obs['leiden'] == cluster_id
    other_mask = ~cluster_mask
    
    # Calculate mean expression
    cluster_mean = adata[cluster_mask].X.mean(axis=0).A1 if hasattr(adata[cluster_mask].X, 'A') else adata[cluster_mask].X.mean(axis=0)
    other_mean = adata[other_mask].X.mean(axis=0).A1 if hasattr(adata[other_mask].X, 'A') else adata[other_mask].X.mean(axis=0)
    
    # Calculate fold change
    fc = cluster_mean / (other_mean + 1e-10)
    fc = np.log2(fc + 1e-10)
    
    # Get gene names
    gene_names = adata.var_names
    
    # Create dataframe
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        'gene': gene_names,
        'log2fc': fc,
        'cluster_mean': cluster_mean,
        'other_mean': other_mean
    })
    
    df = df.sort_values('log2fc', ascending=False).head(n)
    return df

# Get markers for clusters 3, 12, 18
for cluster in [3, 12, 18, 0]:
    print(f"\n{'='*60}")
    print(f"Cluster {cluster} markers (n={adata.obs['leiden'].value_counts()[cluster]} cells)")
    print(f"{'='*60}")
    markers = get_top_markers(cluster, n=15)
    print(markers[['gene', 'log2fc', 'cluster_mean']].to_string(index=False))
